description: Taiwan termination: notice period 10/20/30 days by service (勞動基準法 第16條), severance under the new pension system 0.5 month per year up to 6 months (勞工退休金條例 第12條) or the old system 1 month per year (勞基法 第17條), special leave days by service up to 30 (第38條), unemployment benefit at 60% of insured wage for 6 months, or 9 months at 45+ or with a disability (就業保險法 第16條), and the dates for paying severance (within 30 days) and the 5-year wage claim limitation (民法 第126條). Items also show the minimum wage (29,500 TWD a month / 196 an hour in 2026; 30,900 / 205 from 2027-01-01) and warn when the average monthly wage is below it. Taiwan (law.moj.gov.tw), as of 2026-11-21. General information and estimates only: no legal advice, no representation, no filing; values that could not be verified are flagged in the result, not computed.
